newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen drifting in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen drifting in directionless trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to drift in a limited range in the Friday trading session due to a lack of direction, brokers said.
Real estate shares, which were active on the previous day, are seen continuing to rally while high technology issues, which have been rising in recent sessions, take a break, they added.
On Thursday, the 225-share Nikkei average rose 155.72 points or 0.77 percent to close at 20,286.23.
September Nikkei futures rose 200 points to end at 20,330.
"If real estate issues continue to rise, the bullishness may spread to other sectors, such as construction, which have been doing poorly lately," a general manager at a second-tier brokerage said.
Brokers added that as today was Friday and the end of the trading month was near, dealers would be reluctant to participate actively and trade was likely to be thin.
On Thursday, only 342 million shares were traded.
